description: DATENAME calc translation. Tableau DATENAME('month'|'weekday', date) → MonthName/WeekdayName; numeric units ('year'|'quarter') → Text(Year(...))/Text(Quarter(...)). Before the fix, DATENAME was absent from the function map, so the unit got quote-fixed but the function name stayed DATENAME(...) — an untranslated SQL function that resolves to a type:error column at query time (noErrorColumns catches it). Targets CSA.TJ.DATE_DIM (FULL_DATE is a real date column).
